    Splittings of biproducts #

    • The splitting lemma: a split monomorphism f : A ⟶ X in an abelian category gives X ≅ A ⊞ cokernel f (isoBiprodCokernelOfIsSplitMono).
    • A finite biproduct over Fin (n+1) splits off its first summand: ⨁_{Fin (n+1)} f ≅ f 0 ⊞ ⨁_{Fin n} f ∘ succ (biproductFinSuccIso).
